burrow.controller: set under=true, interpolate root X/Z to marked destination and lower world Y; 1.6 s surface warning; full submersion is root-owned

surface.fire: all 8 RingShotSockets simultaneously at controller event, shellSpeed=3.2, bounces=0; orient from each live world quaternion; no visual startup delays gameplay

ordinary_fire.source: bossAim normal cooldown 2.4; aimed shell 9, bounces 0

kill.controller: stop wheel/drill motors; no living crew, no escape pod

mixing: One full-body pose writer. Controller uses a separate WorldController parent above the glTF TOY_QUOTA root; all clip TRS stay local and in-place. Surface -> Pop_Up -> Idle/Travel; RingShot is an optional standalone display/recoil recipe only, do not stack with Pop_Up. Reset full restTRS before Idle after Toy_Disabled/Battery_Service. AimYaw demonstration +/-20deg; runtime aim has real +Y yaw pivot, limit +/-20deg to keep arm clear. No scale animation.

travel.retime: playbackRate=controllerVelocity/(2pi*0.32); only exposed driven hubs rotate, sealed elastic belt remains fixed; no moving UV requirement

triggerEvidence.reinforcement: miner at hp<=0.5 is controller-owned; no extra figure supplied

coordinateMapping.source: reference/tanks-3d.js:2-4,533-536; tanks.js fireShell and drill ring loop
coordinateMapping.assetAzimuth: RingShotSocket k local forward = (sin(0.2+k*pi/4),0,cos(0.2+k*pi/4)); local 0 means asset +Z

canonicalSurfaceRing.setWhile: during hidden root-owned burrow, before surface
canonicalSurfaceRing.socketKGameAngle: 0.2-k*pi/4 modulo 2pi; reverse socket iteration yields exactly the legacy eight-angle set 0.2+i*pi/4
canonicalSurfaceRing.reason: Legacy ring phase is world-fixed, independent of tk.aim. Do not accidentally add the current body aim to that phase.
canonicalSurfaceRing.worldDirections: Transform live socket +Z by actual matrixWorld at surface after setting the specified controller heading.
